entities.summary: Justin Rodrell Gilbert is an American professional football cornerback for the Sioux City Bandits of the National Arena League (NAL). He was selected by the Cleveland Browns with the eighth pick in the 2014 NFL draft, after playing college football at Oklahoma State. He has also been a member of the Pittsburgh Steelers.
